title: Inverse Wave Problems on Graphs
summary: We study inverse wave problems on finite graphs from time-dependent measurements on a prescribed set of vertices. With the graph geometry known, we consider recovery of either the initial signal or the vertex wave speeds when the other is given. Initial-signal recovery is characterized by observability of the associated finite-dimensional system, while a single experiment determines the vertex wave speeds under a zero forcing condition and a natural nonharmonicity assumption.
